display.purpose: Dashboard identity only; reduce scale during redesign.

body.purpose: Readable product UI labels, prose, controls, and data rows.

elevation.philosophy: Layered but restrained; prefer tone and borders before glow.

rules.northStar: Local health data management and insights. Calm, trustworthy, flexible.
dos: Keep source, recency, units, and safety boundaries visible.
Distinguish deterministic analytics from AI-generated interpretation.
Use restrained layers and meaningful state color.
donts: Do not imply diagnosis, treatment, medication changes, urgent triage, or clinical certainty.
Do not expand glassy panels or wide glow shadows as default decoration.
Do not hide browser focus outlines or rely on color-only status.
